profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Graduate Student at University of Southern California specializing in Electrical Engineering (Computer Networks) and graduating in May 2015 with interests in Computer Networks,Cloud Computing & Security, Software Defined Networking and Operating Systems.

Experienced in Kernel Development and also in a development of Linux kernel internals,such as Virtual File Systems, Virtual Memory and Multithreaded Programming. 

Gained experience of 2 years as a research assistant, Engineering Intern and Systems Engineer. In addition, currently working as a Student Researcher under Prof. Kai Hwang in the field of Cloud Computing and Security. 
In addition, working on a research project under mentor Masoud Moshref in field of Software Defined Networking. 

Technical Skills: 

->Languages: C, C++, Python, Perl
->Networking Software: Cisco Packet Tracer, Wire shark, GNS3, OPNET, Boson NetSim
->Experience : CISCO 2960 L2 Switches, Cisco Remote Access Networks, CISCO LAN Switch
->Configuration: CISCO 2700 Series Routers, Cisco Inter network Design & Troubleshooting, Cisco        Routing Protocols BGP, OSPF, EIGRP/ IGRP, RIP & Redistribution of routing protocols

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Orchestrating the development and oversight of the WCNP platform, managing global containerized workloads with Kubernetes and Golang.
Providing consultancy services to optimize cloud solutions, oversee cluster management, and develop automation tools, resulting in a 70% increase in platform efficiency.
Navigated Walmart's tech infrastructure during peak periods, maintaining a remarkable 99.9% uptime.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Pioneered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) strategies leveraging Python, Ansible, Terraform, and AWS public cloud technologies. Spearheaded performance tracking and automation initiatives, resulting in a 60% efficiency improvement for Cisco's IoT platform. Additionally, led a cross-functional team in the implementation of microservice architecture to enhance Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) services organization-wide.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-> Designed and implemented a secure infrastructure for next-gen live streaming applications on GCP, supporting a 200% increase in user capacity. -> Automated infrastructure creation using Terraform, and developed backend APIs using NodeJS and Python, reducing system latency by 80%.
-> Designed a software which was an effort aimed at replacing the API and orchestration pieces within Cisco Cloud Services and was a full-featured service catalog product that is mostly intended for building enterprise-category e-shop experiences. Software had extended to support a wide variety of different use-cases such as exposing APIs, interacting with a backend services, website hosting and many more.
-> Responsible for developing custom modules and enhancement for openstack components like Horizon.
-> Created a Python-based tool to automate CI/CD pipelines, increasing release speed by 50%.
-> Developed a customer friendly web application for budget management using Java, Spring boot and MongoDB.
-> Launched AI/ML efforts, positioning the organization for future tech advancements and delivered anomaly detection algorithm for telecommunication database.
-> Configuring and troubleshooting automation components of Cisco’s large scale OpenStack IaaS platform. Ensuring full High Availability configuration.
-> Configuring and troubleshooting OpenStack components: Horizon, Keystone, and HA Proxy.
-> Providing technical knowledge transfers to other team-members about Openstack Horizon component.	
-> Developing modules for Ansible based automation frameworks and platform orchestration.
-> Conducting TOI sessions on OpenStack Horizon and Cisco CR procedure and SDLC GO pipelines
-> Planning releases and creating Method Of Procedure a.k.a. “runbook” documentation
-> Coordinating change management and executing changes according to CM/CR process and responsible for on-call incidents managed by PagerDuty

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: -> Worked as a Software engineer and developed python Django based web application.

positions.title: NOC Student Operator
positions.description:
-> To Monitor the whole network of USC university park campus and Health Science campus and of other organizations which are operated by ITS with the help of spectrum, Inter-mapper and SCC Display.
-> Resolving problems regarding network and related to ITS support system.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: ->Working on a research project under Prof. Kai Hwang in the field of Cloud Computing & Security.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
->Gained knowledge about networking devices. Configured CISCO 2700 Series Routers and CISCO 2960 Series Switches. 
->Implemented the network of enterprise in IPv4 and IPv6 and configured routers for the communication between IPv4 and IPv6 using all three methods(Tunneling, NAT-PT and Dual Stack). 
->In addition, configured VLAN, Inter VLAN, VOIP, MAC Security, Routing Protocols (RIP, EIGRP, OSPF,IGRP), Redistribution of Routing and other protocols of routing and switching.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
->Completed course of "Network Tech & Devices" and implemented different routing / switching protocols practically. 
->Configured Routing & Switching Protocols on CISCO routers & switches and simulated routing protocols and switching protocols using CISCO Packet Tracer.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description:
->Gained knowledge of Computer Hardware & Networking.Configured routers and switches.
->Performed troubleshooting on the problems related to computer hardware & networking. 
->Monitored packets generated during communication process between routers and systems.

projects.title: Virtualizing Network Traffic Shapers in SDN
projects.description:
-> Implemented different policies of mapping a set of queuing policies to a smaller set of traffic shapers on a single switch using OpenFlow protocol.
->Further Expansion: Implementation and comparison of two different algorithms for the same approach.

projects.title: Development of Image Processing Application on AWS cloud with Social Media Integration
projects.description: In a team of 4, implemented & applied Image Processing filters for various visual effects. Integrated application with social media to share pictures on Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter using respective media APIs. Use PageRank algorithm on Intel HiBench suite for analysis of cloud resources utilization.
